name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: The Potter's levy is lower than both Matilda and the artisan serving the Baron.
The artisan in Eastcheap's levy is between Wulfric and the Mason.
Potter goes with exactly two of Wulfric, Riverside, Prince, and 14 coins.
If 14 coins goes with Riverside, then Wulfric goes with Weaver.
14 coins goes with at most one of Godfrey, Weaver, Millpond, and Baron.
